result.summary: In 2025 Liang Wenfeng gave no interviews and published no essays or posts. His public appearances were two government symposiums (Jan 20 with Premier Li Qiang, where his words were not published, and Feb 17 with Xi Jinping), plus his name as corresponding author on the September 2025 Nature R1 paper. The AGI timeline often credited to him in 2025 comes from a July 2024 interview, and his later timed remarks are from a May 2026 investor meeting.

reply_text:
I found no dated AI prediction from Liang Wenfeng in 2025. He gave no interviews and published no essays or posts that year, and every timed AI statement I found was made in another year. All three fixed searches ran, so I've marked this a quiet year.

- **His one known speech in 2025 left no record of what he said.** He spoke at Premier Li Qiang's symposium on 20 January 2025. The news report I opened confirms he spoke but doesn't give his words. The lines it quotes come from a 2019 speech and his 2024 interview.
- **The often-quoted AGI timeline is from 2024, not 2025.** "It could be 2 years, 5 years, or 10 years, but it will definitely happen within our lifetime" was widely reprinted in January 2025. The translator says the interview was done six months earlier, so it was July 2024. I've listed it under other_years. The same translation says startups can join "at any point in the next 20 years." That line may come from his 2023 interview instead, and I couldn't tell which.
- **The leaked investor meeting is from 2026.** One translation says the meeting took place on 20 May 2026, and the full translation I opened was posted 23 July 2026. In it he lays out an AGI path but gives no date for it. His timed lines there are about chips, which are business forecasts.

One page wouldn't open: an August 2026 Sina article saying he hadn't given an interview since early 2025. I haven't quoted it. A Chinese news headline in the search results made the same claim, but I didn't open that page.

I used 11 of the 12 searches and 4 of the 6 page openings. One page failed and three opened.
